title: Spanning rows and columns
learningObjectives: Use spanning rows and columns correctly and accessibly.

understand.concept: colspan makes a cell cover multiple columns; rowspan covers multiple rows. Spanning changes the table grid, so ensure each row remains structurally consistent.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct semantic structure improves meaning, accessibility and maintainability.
understand.analogy: Think of a carefully organised record book.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is limited; browser semantics and accessibility are defined by HTML.

explain.narrative: colspan makes a cell cover multiple columns; rowspan covers multiple rows. Spanning changes the table grid, so ensure each row remains structurally consistent.

examples.explanation: Inspect attributes, element nesting and labels. Run the example and modify it in your browser.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the semantic HTML structure.
